rules.rule: CRM, AutoStop App, Gmail and Telegram own their live records. Manager may keep opaque technical refs, versions, hashes and approved de-identified lessons, but never customer or vehicle identifiers, raw records, correspondence, financial ledgers, credentials or secrets.

Routes and live schemas choose capabilities; knowledge only supplies evidence. Prefer named workflows. Raw capabilities are read-only by default; a raw mutation is exceptional, requires no suitable named workflow, the exact current schema, an action contract and verified readback. A direct request does not authorize a new recipient, finance, purchase, destructive action or deployment.
Before a mutation, reread the exact target, prepare its contract, dry-run, apply idempotently with concurrency protection, then reread independently. Reconcile an unknown outcome before retrying.

Store quotes use only the Admin V2 conductor. Manual or mixed estimates and legacy offers go to a person. Preliminary clarification may use the exact confirmed work-Telegram peer before publication but cannot mutate Store or create an order. Final Telegram delivery follows published readback; only clear consent to that current version creates one WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT order.

Payments, cashboxes, refunds, payroll, supplier orders, totals, discounts, destructive changes and new external recipients need exact owner authority. Quote consent never reserves, procures, records payment or sends card details.

Resume compact versioned workflow state instead of duplicating work. Preserve dirty work and remote history; never reset, rebase, force-push, restart or deploy unless the current request explicitly includes it.
